lines: Called support of yoni known, called root of trident is called; letters there dissolution go, in devoid of letters in letter-formed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yonyādhāreti vikhyātā śūlamūleti śabdyate varṇāstatra layaṃ yānti hyavarṇe varṇarūpiṇi
